tagline: Istanbul's oldest beach resort area — historic seafront facilities, family beach clubs, and a long coastal promenade on the Sea of Marmara.

items.name: Florya Sosyal Tesisleri Café
items.description: The historic Florya Social Facilities complex right on the sea — a beloved Istanbul institution with a seafront terrace.
items.tip: The wooden pavilions over the sea are from the 1930s Atatürk era. Order tea and sit by the water.

items.name: Florya Sahil Restoranları
items.description: Restaurants along the Florya seafront with Marmara views. Family-friendly, local, and good value.

items.name: Florya Sahili
items.description: A long seaside promenade with beach clubs, walking paths, and one of Istanbul's best coastal parks. Popular with families.

items.name: Atatürk'ün Florya Köşkü
items.description: The wooden sea villa used by Atatürk as a summer retreat — now a museum set on stilts over the sea. A fascinating piece of Turkish history.

tips: Florya is on the Marmaray (Florya station) — about 30 minutes from the city centre.
The beach area is free but beach clubs charge entry. The coastal walk is always accessible.
Best visited in spring or autumn — summer heat and crowds can be intense.
Combine with Yeşilköy (east) for a pleasant coastal day.
